title: Step 5: the focused form field gets a red-orange ring that reads as an error
where: /admin/new, any focused field (global outline-ring/50, --ring is terracotta), 1440×900
what_happens: The Question box I'd just filled shows a red-orange outline, the same look as the invalid Link name a moment before. Dane agreed with this on the sign-in page; it's the same global ring here.
who_hurts: An admin editing the draft: each field they click looks like it has an error.
suggested_fix: Same fix as agreed for sign-in: a neutral or primary-green focus ring (--ring in globals.css), so red stays for errors.
rule: established pattern: earlier agreed finding on sign-in focus ring
step: 5: edit the draft in the form
